title: M6.3: plan-save conflict detection and crash-safe offline edit queue (two new modules)
derivation: Real merged PR #365 at its exact base: the historical M6.3 briefing as the instruction, with an explicit contract section added so hidden checks are deterministic; base files are empty stubs; the reference is the merged pair of modules. Hidden scenarios re-express the PR's 21 vitest cases (plus enqueue-failure propagation) as fake-fs/GitHub observations; assertions stay on the trusted host. v2 (MB-010c follow-up): native admission found the instruction's 'never double-apply' contradicts the merged oracle, which keeps a saved entry queued when cleanup fails and may re-save it. The oracle is the real merged code, so only the instruction changed: it now states no-loss, at-least-once delivery with the cleanup-failure re-save explicitly allowed. No hidden check requires exactly-once on that path. v3: literal-overspecification audit (MB-010r-literal-audit.json, sha256 73c2e9f82e51fffa99fb102c6f2c711252404dbcdee093f8d608df2586484412): queue id 'filesystem-safe' checked as /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/ -> rejects only path separators, reserved, whitespace and control characters and '.'/'..'. Instruction and oracle unchanged.
coverage: Two new TypeScript modules: 7 conflict, 4 enqueue and 9 replay behavior checks.
residual_rubric: Module documentation of the changed-files gap is requested but not graded.
